description: This file defines the 'CategoryService' interface, which specifies methods for adding, reading, and deleting categories within the billing software. It includes method signatures for handling category data and associated file uploads.

classes.name: CategoryService
classes.description: Defines the contract for category-related operations such as adding, reading, and deleting categories, potentially involving file uploads.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new category based on the provided request data and an uploaded file, may throw IOException.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all category responses.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a category identified by the given category ID.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new category with associated file; takes CategoryRequest and MultipartFile as parameters, returns CategoryResponse.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves all categories as a list of CategoryResponse.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a category specified by its ID.
